correctness.rationale: Under finite second moments, the exact orthogonal martingale covariance sum and lower-triangular binomial expansion show that solely the type-one/type-one innovation channel has degree i+j; its leading coefficient is b1*v*c_i*c_j/((i-1)!(j-1)!(i+j-1)(i+j)), all other channels are O(n^(i+j-1)). Positive leading variances permit O(1/n) Pearson normalization. Jacobi-Gram monic norms prove strict positivity and the closed determinant. 417 exact rational checks in 18 sample models and 9 Gram sizes supplement but do not establish the infinite theorem.
